definitions.acceptance: Runner accepted boolean; not semantic oracle correctness.
definitions.coverage: Trial line_pct is module coverage; acceptance-penalized mean includes every planned attempt. Pack coverage is union over locked eligible modules; its denominator and selected suite composition differ from standalone coverage.
definitions.equal_project: Within each represented project average all selected target-seed pairs, then give each represented project equal weight.
definitions.paired_counts: Treatment/control named explicitly. For context-source, treatment_only=context_only and control_only=source_only. Counts are target-seed pairs.
definitions.seed: Two labels are repetitions within projects; descriptive sensitivity does not estimate broad seed uncertainty.
definitions.status: Terminal runner categories, not independent causal mechanisms or cumulative gate probabilities. test_failure can include collection failures; no finer label inferred.
definitions.subgroups: Exhaustive manifest-defined strata, retaining all arms, both seeds and failures. Each stratum balances its represented projects; project sets may differ across strata. Cross-stratum comparisons are descriptive and confounded, not interaction estimates.

evidence_sources: All trial metrics use attempts/*/outcome.json, cross-checked exactly against outcomes.jsonl and summary.json; target attributes use manifest.json; pack metrics use packs/*/pack_result.json matched to joint summary. input_sha256 maps every input used.
scope: Exploratory post hoc descriptive analysis of the complete frozen full-scope experiment. Existing inference reproduced only; no new subgroup tests, exclusions, repairs, or case filtering.
